roleplay.title: Shopping for clothes in Mong Kok

hints.en: Ask if they have a blue top.
t: jau5 mou5 laam4 sik1 ge3 saam1 aa3?

hints.en: Ask if they have a bigger one.
t: jau5 mou5 daai6 di1 ge3 aa3?

hints.en: Ask if you can try it on.
t: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5 aa3?

hints.en: Say the blue one is cheaper than the red one, and you'll take the blue one.
t: 藍色嗰件比紅色嗰件平，我要藍色嘅。
laam4 sik1 go2 gin6 bei2 hung4 sik1 go2 gin6 peng4, ngo5 jiu3 laam4 sik1 ge3.

hints.en: Say Chicago is smaller than Hong Kong.
t: zi1 gaa1 go1 bei2 hoeng1 gong2 sai3.

hints.en: Say Chicago isn't as hot as Hong Kong.
t: zi1 gaa1 go1 mou5 hoeng1 gong2 gam3 jit6.

hints.en: Say you like Chicago's parks: they're big and clean.
t: 我鍾意芝加哥嘅公園，好大，好乾淨。
ngo5 zung1 ji3 zi1 gaa1 go1 ge3 gung1 jyun2, hou2 daai6, hou2 gon1 zeng6.

hints.en: Say you like Chicago best, because your home is there.
t: 我最鍾意芝加哥，因為我屋企喺嗰度。
ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zi1 gaa1 go1, jan1 wai6 ngo5 uk1 kei2 hai2 go2 dou6.
